_comment: The overworld here is typed octia:sky, not minecraft:overworld, and that is the whole fix for the draining sea. The two files disagreed: octia:sky's noise settings say min_y 0 / height 256, while minecraft:overworld says min_y -64 / height 384, so 64 rows of world existed that the generator never wrote to. See data/octia/dimension_type/sky.json and docs/ISLANDS.md X. The Nether and the End stay exactly vanilla.
